senses.sense_definition: A medical device used to administer medicine to the lungs by converting a liquid into a fine mist to be inhaled.

examples.text: The doctor recommended using a portable <w>nebulizer</w> whenever the child had trouble breathing.
He poured the liquid medicine into the cup of the <w>nebulizer</w> and attached the mask.

senses.sense_definition: A device used to convert any liquid into a fine spray or aerosol.

examples.text: The laboratory uses an ultrasonic <w>nebulizer</w> to create a consistent aerosol mist for the experiment.
Each <w>nebulizer</w> was tested to ensure the droplets remained uniform across different pressure settings.
